programs.title: Hail Mary
programs.desc: Popular writer Maria (Laura Weissmahr) has recently become a mother.Her days are filled with caring for her son and visiting doctors.There is virtually no time left to create.To make matters worse, the husband keeps postponing the promised paternity leave and ignores the difficulties his wife is facing.At this time, Barcelona is shaken by information about the crime committed by a young French woman who drowned her 10-month-old twins in the bathtub.Maria follows this case with increasing attention, which slowly becomes her obsession.

programs.title: The Angry Birds Movie
programs.desc: A flock of colorful flightless birds lives on a quiet, exotic island.In this paradise community, there is no shortage of outsiders, such as the hot-tempered Red, the quick-as-the-wind Chuck, and the explosive Bomb.Unexpectedly, their happiness is interrupted by the appearance of mysterious green pigs.The picture impresses with its refined animation.Full of humor and positive energy, the production, whose plot refers to the popular smartphone game "Angry Birds", will appeal to both younger and older viewers.The film was directed by two debutants: Clay Kaytis and Fergal Reilly;and in the Polish version you can hear the voices of, among others:Jacek Bończyk, Janusz Zadura, Piotr Bąk and Marta Dobecka.

programs.title: The Angry Birds Movie 2
programs.desc: The colorful flock of flightless birds and the cunning green pigs continue to quarrel and cannot stand each other's presence.Unexpectedly, however, they have to call a truce and forget about their disagreements.Their islands are threatened by a completely new enemy, whom they can only defeat by fighting side by side.Red, Bomba, Chuck and his sister Silver get along with Leonard and his crew.The second film inspired by a popular smartphone game.In the Polish language version, the voices were: Jacek Bończyk (Red), Agnieszka Mrozińska (Silver), Janusz Zadura (Chuck), Piotr Bąk (Bomba), Paweł Szczęsny (Leonard).

programs.title: Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince
programs.desc: Harry Potter and his friends, Hermione and Ron, are starting their sixth year at Hogwarts.Magic school is no longer a safe place.The teaching staff is changing.Horace Slughorn becomes a potions teacher, and Severus Snape conducts Defense Against the Dark Arts classes.Meanwhile, Harry, supported by Albus Dumbledore, tries to learn about Lord Voldemort's dark past.The new professor can help with this, but he does not want to admit the mistake he made many years ago.Potter borrows a mysterious textbook that formerly belonged to the Half-Blood Prince.Thanks to the previous owner's notes there, he becomes top student in Potions classes.At the same time, he is preparing for a fight with the Dark Lord.Together with Dumbledore, he searches for horcruxes - magical objects in which Voldemort locked pieces of his soul.However, Harry does not know that his powerful enemy has a spy at Hogwarts.He was given a task by Voldemort.

programs.title: Monsieur Aznavour
programs.desc: Paris, 1930s. The son of immigrants takes part in a theater performance.This is how he discovers his vocal talent and decides to become a singer.A breakthrough in his career was his meeting with Edith Piaf.

programs.title: Dune: Part Two
programs.desc: After an insidious attack by the Harkonnens and the death of his father, Paul Atreides (Timothée Chalamet) and his pregnant mother, Jessica (Rebecca Ferguson), hide in the desert among the Fremen.There, a young man's feelings for Chani (Zendaya) sprout.At the same time, he matures spiritually.The leader of the wandering people, Stilgar (Javier Bardem), closely observes the only descendant of the Atreides family and becomes convinced that he is the chosen one, whose coming has been predicted for generations.However, to be accepted by the Fremen, Paul must pass the ultimate test by riding a monstrous worm.Meanwhile, Baron Vladimir Harkonnen (Stellan Skarsgard) finds out that Paul is alive.He knows he has to hurry.He decides to take control of the entire planet Arrakis.He starts launching attack after attack.A continuation of the spectacular production from 2021, which was awarded six Oscars.Both films are adaptations of the famous science fiction novel by Frank Herbert.
